stops.name: Haut-Languedoc Regional Nature Park
stops.detail: Haut-Languedoc Regional Nature Park (French: Parc naturel régional du Haut-Languedoc; Occitan: Parc Natural Regional del Naut-Languedoc) is a regional natural park in the south of the Massif Central within the Aveyron, Hérault, and Tarn departments of France. These areas are considered the Haut-Languedoc, compared to the Bas-Languedoc.
